name: DB Connector
description: Save PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite connections (passwords in Orca's secrets or from AWS Secrets Manager), browse schemas and run queries from a sidebar panel, and let the agents Orca launches query them through a local MCP server. Agent writes wait for your approval unless a connection allows them; every query is logged with its rows.

settings.title: Agent access
settings.description: What agents launched from Orca may do through the DB gateway and the orca-db MCP server. With "Read and write", a write still waits for your approval unless the connection allows agent writes at once (never on a dangerous connection).

settings.title: Add the MCP server to Claude Code
settings.description: Pass --mcp-config to Claude Code launches so the orca-db tools are available without setup. Other agents get ORCA_DB_GATEWAY_URL, ORCA_DB_GATEWAY_TOKEN and ORCA_DB_MCP_SERVER in their environment.

settings.title: Approval timeout (ms)
settings.description: How long an agent write waits for your decision in the panel before it fails.

settings.title: Query timeout (ms)
settings.description: A query that runs longer than this is cancelled by the server (PostgreSQL and MySQL).

settings.title: Max rows per query
settings.description: Rows past this limit are dropped and the result is marked as truncated.
